Kalki
a. alias of Narasiṁha Aiyangar.
See NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 188.

Kalkipurāṇa
in 35 adhys. on the deeds of Viṣṇu in the coming tenth Avatāra a. the end of Kaliyuga, when he will be born a. the son of Viṣṇuyaśas an. Sumati a. Śambhalagrāma. Col.. ref. to it a. Aṇu(nu)bhāgavata.
See also under Anubhāgavata, NCC. I. Revised edn. p. 207b.
